text:
Maria Chen: Quick async check — mid-quarter OKR milestone review for infra + runtime features. I pulled a short list: what actually shipped last sprint, what slipped, and immediate next steps/owners. Please update inline with short lines.

Alice Kim: Shipped — runtime v2 batching turned on for 25% of hosted traffic. Telemetry shows 15% token-cost drop in the canopy tests. :tada:

Devin O'Neill: Shipped — metrics pipeline for per-model token breakdown. Dashboards in Console -> Cost > Model. Still doing a follow-up to add per-route breakdown.

Raj Patel: Slipped — Dedicated capacity autoscaler work blocked on vmimage update; infra image has security patch that regressed nvidia driver load. Working w/ infra on rollback or patched image. ETA 2 days.

Priya Singh: Action item for Raj — can you add a short PR describing the failure mode and rollback steps? put it in the dedicated rollout epic so PMs can see.

Raj Patel: Will do, PR #4823 coming in by EOD.

Tom S: FYI, code review ping for runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1287 — needs a perf run and a second +1. @Alice can you add perf baseline?

Alice Kim: On it. I’ll run perf with the 512 token profile and post a short summary in the PR.

Ezra (PM): From product side — important to know if Dedicated autoscale is delayed >48h so we can adjust customer comms. If rollback is needed, flag escalation to enterprise-symptoms channel.

Raj Patel: Noted. If driver patch fails, plan B is a soft rollback to previous image and keep customers on reserved capacity; I’ll confirm timelines in PR.

Maria Chen: What slipped vs. shipped summary (short bullets) so I can fold into the OKR tracker?

Devin O'Neill: Shipped: metrics pipeline, canary batching change, small runtime hotfix. Slipped: dedicated autoscaler, KV-cache eviction tuning (blocked by perf regression).

Priya Singh: Owners / next-actions:
- Dedicated autoscaler: Raj (owner) — PR #4823, need infra image resolution, ETA 48h
- KV-cache tuning: Alice + Devin — reproduce perf regression on staging, ETA 3 days
- Telemetry dashboard: Devin — product requested per-route breakdown, ETA 2 days

Tom S: Quick ask — can owners add a one-line acceptance criteria for each bullet so SRE/Support know the criteria for "done"? e.g., "autoscaler: can sustain 2x baseline requests for 10m without OOMs"

Alice Kim: Acceptance criteria added inline in the epic doc (link): https://docs.redwood.ai/okrs/infra/epic-142 — updated now.

Ezra (PM): Also add a rollback plan for the autoscaler in the same epic. Customers want clarity.

Raj Patel: Adding rollback steps to PR and epic. Will tag @deploy-bot for deploy checklist.

deploy-bot: Deploy checklist queued: PR #4823 -> staging -> canary -> prod. Automated smoke tests: runtime-smoke, metrics-smoke.

Priya Singh: Risk callouts: enterprise customers on Dedicated may see scheduling delays; recommend we hold new onboarding till autoscaler is stable.

Maria Chen: OK — final asks before I close the thread and update the OKR doc:
1) Raj: PR + rollback steps by EOD (2945670001 + 6h)
2) Alice/Devin: reproduce KV perf regression + mitigation note in 72h
3) Devin: per-route telemetry in 48h
4) Tom: perf signoff on runtime PR once Alice posts baseline

Alice Kim: Confirmed.

Devin O'Neill: Confirmed.

Raj Patel: Confirmed — PR in progress.

Ezra (PM): I’ll draft a short customer note template for enterprise support to use if we hit delays.

Maria Chen: Perfect — I’ll update OKR tracker after confirmations. Thanks everyone for quick asyncs. :thumbsup:
